main_text.l: ce viuere, Regique Serenissimo primùm, deinde Illustrissimo VV allia Principi placere, vt operam tuam, illis in primis probatam, patria vtilem sentiat, ad supremi numinis gloriam sempiternam propagandam, Christi Domini nostri Iesu veritatem propugnandam, Antichristi vanitatem oppugnandam & expugnandam. Amen. Fœliciter vale. Geneuæ Cal. Aug. An. CIↄ DCVIII.
T. D. Illustris. Deditis. ANTONIVS FAYVS.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (diamond-shaped floral design) is not transcribed.
